_comment: Obligations that must never reach the published site, by id (the
sync_todos already withholds anything sourced from a mailbox, and anything
whose title says retake / resit / remedial or counts its own audience
('(8 students)'). This file is for everything else that is yours alone and
does not announce itself -- add the id and it is held back, and named in
the run output so you can see it was.

life-vlsts-validation-receipt: Immigration status. source: canvas and namespace: life, so neither the mailbox
guard nor the retake guard is meant to catch it. A dry run on 2 Oct 2026 did hold
it back -- but only because its found_only_in line happens to contain the word
'mail' ('no mail, feed or page states this'). That is a coincidence of wording,
not a guard: reword that line and it publishes.
What it would have put on a public page: that the author may hold a French
long-stay visa still needing validation. Nobody else's business, and not undone
life-fbl-register-your-immigration-statu: Immigration, same as life-vlsts-validation-receipt. Its title also states that her own
Canvas survey is done and when -- personal submission state, which this site withholds by
acc-fa-assignment-5-netflix-case-may-be-: Title carries her submission timestamp, her uploaded filename and her group id
('SUBMITTED Tue 15 Sep 2026 18:25 CEST as E01-G11 Netflix Case.pdf'). The deadline itself is
cohort information; none of the rest is.
atl-community-challenge-group-submission: Title says a groupmate submitted it and that Canvas still counts it missing against her.
Third-party action plus her own standing. Was LIVE on the public site until 2 Oct 2026.
atl-community-challenge-peer-review: Title attributes the work to a named-by-implication groupmate 'on behalf of the team'.
Somebody else's business. Was LIVE on the public site until 2 Oct 2026.
atl-community-challenge-individual-prepa: Title explains that a Canvas 'missing' flag against her is spurious -- her own standing,
and meaningless to any other reader.
